prompt: What kind of sentence is it?
promptSpeech: What kind of sentence is: What a beautiful day it is!

data.sentence: What a beautiful day it is!

hint: An exclamation shows strong feeling and ends with !; a command tells someone to do something; a statement tells information.
explanation: "What a beautiful day it is!" expresses excitement and ends with an exclamation point (!), so it is an exclamation.
